# isitahack.com

> Public-source tracking of reported hacks and cyber incidents. Each claim carries a label (Confirmed, Reported, Unverified, Rumor, Debunked, Not established), a source link and a note on why it supports the claim.

## Index
- [index.json](https://isitahack.com/index.json): JSON list of all incidents: slug, title, status, last_updated, paths to its files.

## Pages
- [Home](https://isitahack.com/index.html): HTML list of incidents, generated from each incident's data.
- [How it works](https://isitahack.com/how-it-works.html): who does what, the six labels, the sourcing tiers and the rules the agents work to.
- [About](https://isitahack.com/about.html): why the site exists, who is behind it, and how to report an error.

## Incident pages (Markdown with YAML front-matter, plus a rendered .html)
- [FAA ground stop, Nov 13 2026](https://isitahack.com/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop.md): incident write-up (still monitored). Front-matter: slug, title, status, labels summary, dates.
- [FAA ground stop, Nov 13 2026 (HTML)](https://isitahack.com/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop.html): the same write-up rendered to HTML by scripts/build.mjs.

## Data (CSV, UTF-8, RFC 4180, header row; legacy schema, not yet the manual's claims/sources/timeline/update_log schema)
- [airport_delays.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/airport_delays.csv): columns airport,time_et,avg_delay_min,display
- [cancellations.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/cancellations.csv): columns time_et,cancellations
- [carriers.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/carriers.csv): columns title,detail
- [delays.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/delays.csv): columns time_et,delays
- [flights_in_air.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/flights_in_air.csv): columns time_et,today,yesterday_same_time
- [glance_figures.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/glance_figures.csv): columns figure,source
- [glance_metrics.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/glance_metrics.csv): columns value,label,detail,tone
- [key_events.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/key_events.csv): columns time_et,title,detail
- [official_sources.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/official_sources.csv): columns statement,source
- [open_items.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/open_items.csv): columns item,status,note
- [ruled_out.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/ruled_out.csv): columns area,finding,source
- [sdr_search.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/sdr_search.csv): columns source,result,label
- [side_threads.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/side_threads.csv): columns item,finding,label
- [smart_docs.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/smart_docs.csv): columns source,what_it_says,support
- [smart_procurement.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/smart_procurement.csv): columns item,record,support,label
- [sources.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/sources.csv): columns title,site,href
- [status.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/status.csv): columns key,value
- [theories.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/theories.csv): columns theory,label,gist,source_title,source_url
- [thread_results.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/thread_results.csv): columns thread,verdict,confidence,sources
- [timeline_events.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/timeline_events.csv): columns time_et,event,evidence,label
- [update_log.csv](https://isitahack.com/data/incidents/2026-11-faa-ground-stop/raw/groundstop/data/update_log.csv): columns time_et,update

## Format
- [format/README.md](https://github.com/primeobsession/isitahack-dot-com/blob/main/format/README.md): the typed incident format. New incidents are a folder of JSON and CSV under data/incidents/<slug>/, checked by scripts/validate.mjs.
- [format/incident.schema.json](https://github.com/primeobsession/isitahack-dot-com/blob/main/format/incident.schema.json): JSON Schema for incident.json, with a description of every field.
- [format/tables.schema.json](https://github.com/primeobsession/isitahack-dot-com/blob/main/format/tables.schema.json): column definitions for claims.csv, sources.csv, timeline.csv, questions.csv, quotes.csv and update_log.csv.

## Notes
- Schemas are documented in the operations manual section 6.1.
- Preserved source material for each incident is under data/incidents/<slug>/raw/ with a sha256 MANIFEST.txt.
